# KOASAS (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology Open Access System)

> > KOASAS is KAIST's institutional repository providing open-access discovery and archival of scholarly research outputs including publications, conference papers, and research data.

KOASAS is built on the DSpace platform and serves as KAIST's central digital archive for academic research. It enables researchers and the public to discover, access, and contribute to KAIST's scholarly content through multiple browsing and search interfaces.

## Key Topics

- Institutional Repository
- Open Access
- DSpace Platform
- KAIST Publications
- Academic Research

## Core Discovery & Access

- [KOASAS Home](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr): KOASAS homepage: KAIST's institutional repository for open-access research
- [Search Publications](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/simple-search): Search interface for discovering KAIST academic publications and research
- [Browse by Communities and Collections](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/community-list): Browse KAIST departments and collections in the institutional repository
- [Browse by Author](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/browse-researcher): Browse KAIST researchers and their publications by author name
- [General Browsing](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/browse): Browse metadata and discover research content in DSpace repository

## Repository Information

- [About KOASAS](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/about): About KOASAS: Overview of KAIST's DSpace institutional repository system
- [Keyword Cloud Visualization](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/keyword-cloud): Visualize research trends through keyword cloud of KAIST publications

## Featured Research

- [Fast-Charging Lithium-Ion Battery Technology](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/handle/10203/325124): Conference paper on fast-charging lithium-ion battery technology development
- [Climate Change Impacts on East Asian Monsoon](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/handle/10203/328175): Research on climate change impacts on East Asian monsoon and extreme rainfall
- [Drug-Induced Toxicity Testing via Microphysiological Systems](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/handle/10203/336180): Research on drug toxicity testing using organ-on-chip microphysiological systems
- [Social Commerce and Consumer Behavior on WhatsApp](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/handle/10203/329573): Study on social commerce and consumer behavior via WhatsApp marketing
- [Autonomous Weeding Robot Guidance System](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/handle/10203/202892): Research paper on autonomous weeding robot guidance using rice morphology
- [Music Summarization Using Tempo Tracking](https://koasas.kaist.ac.kr/handle/10203/23072): Conference paper on music summarization using tempo tracking algorithms
